description:
DESIGN TALK (schema, stored data). Needs ag-s99.1 first.

Goal: each run records which pipeline ran and at which version, so the dashboard can show which version runs where.

Glossary (docs/00-glossary.md): Pipeline = a reusable workflow in a central repo, named by its path. Version = the central repo's git ref or SHA. It must come from GitHub (OIDC claims job_workflow_ref and job_workflow_sha), never from the pipeline, so it cannot be faked.

Where: claims are parsed in internal/auth/oidc.go (Claims has JobWorkflowRef; add JobWorkflowSha) and returned as core.Identity. Runs are created in internal/core/report.go and telemetry.go (both take the identity). Runs keep a JSON document (jsonb), so a new field may not need a column, but adding it changes what the server stores: ask Matt.

For a workflow that is not reusable, job_workflow_ref equals workflow_ref; decide with Matt whether to store it then, or leave the pipeline missing (CLAUDE.md: missing measurements stay missing).

Questions for Matt: store ref, SHA or both? Show the pipeline on run pages only, or also on the deployment page?

comments.text: 2026-10-14: recommended answers posted to Matt in the project thread; awaiting his decision before code.

2026-10-14, Matt decided: store both job_workflow_ref and job_workflow_sha on the run (JSON document, no migration). Non-reusable workflow: leave pipeline missing. Show pipeline + version on the run page AND on the deployment page (which version ran).

title: Store pipeline and version on each run
